Description: Green Bay is a mid-sized Lake Michigan bay and Fox River city with an in-city VA outpatient clinic, comparatively low housing costs, a nationally known sports identity, downtown riverfront amenities, nearby parks and fishing access, and explicit local LGBTQ policy strength.
